random_generator: random.Random(seed), independently initialized for each horizon and family

random_walk.sampling: uniform independent choice at each index t=1,...,T-1

regime_switch.sampling: At each t>=1, first apply a uniformly sampled level increment if t is a change index, then add an independently sampled jitter to the current level. The initial observation is zero.

cost_convention: Charge the initial refresh; decisions precede output; discrepancy at each refresh is zero; threshold comparison is strict >.
checks: 72 distinct generated paths and 288 path/charge combinations
exact schedule replay and decomposition J=lambda*N+D
every evaluated policy has cost at least the offline DP cost
existing anytime and clipped analytical bounds
normalization: J/sqrt(lambda*T*V), evaluated in floating point only for this summary; null if V=0
selection: All specified paths, charges and policies are reported.
